description: This file implements a React component plugin for a floating link editor interface within a lexical rich text editor. It provides functionality for editing, displaying, and positioning a link editing UI, including a link preview and editing capabilities.

methods.name: FloatingLinkEditor
methods.description: React component that renders a floating link editor UI, allowing users to modify or view the URL of a selected link, with positioning and focus management.

methods.name: useFloatingLinkEditorToolbar
methods.description: Custom hook that manages the state of the floating link editor toolbar, including whether the current selection is a link.

methods.name: FloatingLinkEditorPlugin
methods.description: Main plugin function that integrates the floating link editor into the Lexical editor using React portal, handling context and positioning.
